integrity: All statements confined to the exactly defined quadratic egg family; numerical approximations are not relied upon for proofs. The finite polynomial checker uses exact rational arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: Only Fefferman boundary Szegő kernels for the exact exponent m=2 and complex dimensions 2..11; no n>=12 or other exponent assertion. Root approximations are descriptive; exact finite Cohn inequalities and gcds certify the counts. Complete motivating preprint was unavailable for publication-priority comparison; independent validation has not been performed.
title: The first Fefferman–Szegő zero in the quadratic egg family occurs in dimension eleven
